description: Card parts cascade in, interactive cards lift on hover and sink while pressed, by pointer or by Space and Enter, and an optional light follows the pointer.
moves: The card fades up, then its header, content and footer arrive in order.
An interactive card lifts 2px on hover and its shadow grows.
It sinks while the pointer holds it down, or while Space or Enter is held on it, and pops back on release.
An optional soft light follows the pointer.
keyboard: On an interactive card you made focusable (with `tabIndex` and a `role`), sinks the card while the key is held, unless your own `onKeyDown` calls `preventDefault()`. What the press does is yours, in `onClick` or `onKeyDown`.

propDocs.Card.interactive: Enable hover lift and press feedback.
propDocs.Card.spotlight: Show a soft wash following the pointer.
